# Message customers of a shop

Send one approved WhatsApp template to a list of customers, label the ones who were sent, and follow up only if they have not replied.

A shop uses Whatsable to tell customers about an order, a restock or an offer, from its own WhatsApp number, and to answer the people who write back.

## Set it up

**Approve the template**

Create the message and submit it to Meta. A broadcast can send only an approved template. See [Message templates](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/message-templates).

**Send it to a list**

Upload a CSV on [Broadcasts](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/broadcasts). Map the phone column and any name or order column the template uses.

**Label the people who were sent**

Add a label on the broadcast. Each recipient gets it after their message is sent. A failed send is not labelled.

**Follow up only the quiet ones**

Schedule a second template with a condition: no reply since your last message, and only if a Bought label is absent. See [Conditional follow-ups](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups).

**Answer in the inbox**

Replies land in the [inbox](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-inbox) on Work, Growth, Pro and Agency. Bulk Message sends the broadcast and has no inbox.

Broadcasts are on Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro and Agency, and during the 14-day trial. A broadcast has no send condition of its own. The later message is a scheduled message, which Bulk Message does not include.

## FAQ

**Can I send a different product to each row?**

Yes. Map each template variable to a CSV column, or type one value for every recipient.

**Does the follow-up send to someone who already replied?**

Not when the condition is no reply. Whatsable checks it when that message is due, and sends nothing if they replied.
